description: Use when you need crypto news or crypto market news headlines about a token or the market from recent articles. Do not use for prices, full article text, social media posts or news older than 72 hours. Returns JSON with the latest crypto news headlines from the last 72 hours (title, link, source, time, tone, people and organizations) about bitcoin, ethereum and blockchain news, from the GDELT news graph for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Search. Price: US$0.005 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

hours.description: How far back to search, in hours (1-72, default 24)

limit.description: Most articles to return (1-50, default 20), newest first

token.description: Narrow to one coin, chain or company, e.g. solana, xrp or coinbase (any crypto news when omitted)

name: blackwood_crypto_news
title: Crypto news
